question: How must the own seeds of Brahmā and Viṣṇu be applied in the consecration rite?
premises: Brahmā and Viṣṇu have their own seeds.
These seeds are placed in the same manner.
They are then used for sprinkling.
inference: The own seeds of Brahmā and Viṣṇu must be placed and used for sprinkling in the same manner.
uncertainties: svabījam: may refer to mantra-seed or consecrated substance
plain_english: Having placed the own seed of Brahmā and Viṣṇu in the same manner, one should sprinkle.
